name: PLY Mesh Loader & Normal Calculator
definition: Parses ASCII PLY files, extracting vertex coordinates and triangle/quad face indices into flat float arrays, and computes face normals via cross product.
summary: This tool parses ASCII PLY files to extract and normalize mesh geometry into a canonical bounding box while computing per-face normals, differing from OBJ loaders by lacking built-in triangulation for non-triangular faces.
